proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7727 pati is Sanskrit husband. These patī forms retain the intervocalic t of the learned word, unlike the regular pai/poi forms in the article; the specific path of learned circulation within Indo-Aryan remains open. Exact survey form patī is retained.
